name: skill-orchestrator
description: Align spoken requirements, retrieve local Agent Skills, plan a safe DAG, execute after confirmation, and verify the result.

interface.shortDescription: Align requirements and safely orchestrate local skills.
interface.longDescription: Turns a spoken need into a confirmed requirement contract, retrieves and reranks local Agent Skills, presents a dependency-aware execution plan, runs only after a second confirmation, and verifies every output.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $skill-orchestrator to align this request, retrieve the right skills, and propose a safe execution plan.
